וְנִדְרָשׁ כֵּן עַל כָּל יוֹם טוֹב.
And this is expounded regarding every Yom Tov.
Why, then, is it written of Pesach “an assembly to Hashem,”
that from the side of Hashem Yisbarach
the holiness of the festival of Pesach was already absorbed
on the seventh day, at the splitting of the Sea.
But for Israel, from their own side,
the time of the Giving of the Torah,
and in the language of our Sages of blessed memory
but that the pleasure of the body
also be in holiness to Hashem,
in the secret of oneg: Eden, Nahar, Gan.
And likewise the meaning of “to Hashem” is
that the sustenance of the body's life
so that his sustenance of life would be
and drink of the wine I have mixed” (Mishlei 9:5).
וְאִיתָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קפו, א):
And it is brought in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 186a):
follows the order of the letters — Aviv, etc.;
is from the end of the letters,” etc.
That is: the holiness of Rosh Hashanah is reish;
the secret of the three Avos (ibid. 204a);
וְאַחַר כָּךְ תָּי״ו, סוּכּוֹת זְמַן שִׂמְחָתֵנוּ,
then tav, Sukkos, the time of our rejoicing,
in which the war of Gog and Magog will take place,
and which is the time to merit that everything be rectified.
וְאַחַר כָּךְ יוּ״ד נֶגֶד שְׁמִינִי עֲצֶרֶת,
And then yud, corresponding to Shemini Atzeres,
which is the wellspring of the Torah,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (תִּקּוּנֵי זֹהַר תִּקּוּן יג, כט, ב):
the yud is chochmah, and its crown
וְהַיְינוּ תּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב וְתוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה.
that is, the Written Torah and the Torah she'b'al peh.
And the letters come in reverse order,
since the shining forth toward the yud
begins with the tav, from Sukkos,
Likewise the piyutim of Hoshana Rabbah:
יֵשׁ בָּהֶם אַרְבָּעָה עַל פִּי אַ״ב,
and one follows tav-shin-reish-kuf and alef-beis —
the number seven, corresponding to the seven middos.
And Hoshana Rabbah is the preparation
for Shemini Atzeres, which is the yud.
Therefore of Pesach it says “to Hashem,”
was preparation for the Giving of the Torah:
from the side of Hashem Yisbarach on the seventh day of Pesach.
Therefore it is “an assembly to Hashem”:
that the words of Torah be for Hashem,
and that the sustenance of life come from the words of Torah,
in the manner of what it says,
when the year is renewed in words of Torah;
on which the last Luchos were given,
which contain Midrash, halachos and aggados
(as stated in Midrash Rabbah, Ki Sisa,
שְׁמוֹת רַבָּה מו, א; מז, ז),
which is the time when they would merit unification
if they merit to rectify everything;
and then on Sukkos, the time of our rejoicing,
which is the time to merit rectifying further
what was not rectified on Yom Kippur.
the holiness of Sukkos, the time of our rejoicing, is absorbed,
and one can rectify all the damage of the serpent,
and of it is said, “an assembly shall be for you” —
and it will also be “to Hashem,”
that it come from Eden, Nahar, Gan.
And even if not everything is rectified,
since the world is judged by its majority,
מִכָּל מָקוֹם כָּל נֶפֶשׁ בִּפְרָט נַפְשׁוֹ
nevertheless each soul, in its own individual soul,
